revisions.text: You didn't come this far to fail, Astral. It's time to enact the ritual.
You're a long way from home, Holliday, but you're so close to finding the killer you seek. Complete the ritual, and I will ensure your success.
You’re a long way from home Holliday, but you're so close to finding the killer you seek.  Complete the ritual and The Archmother will ensure your success.
